notes: Elbow locked, palm facing your thigh: swing the straight arm forward and back like a pendulum, 3 times, fast. Same plane as a curl, no sideways motion.
Shake out your arm and fiddle with the strap for about 15 s, without moving the band. Not a set.
Put the dumbbell down and pick it up again, three times. Not a set.
Count out loud: 9 lifts. Lift 8: lower only until your forearm is level, then start the next lift. All other lifts: full and strict.

Count out loud: 13 lifts. Lifts 5 and 8: lift only until your forearm is level, then lower. Lifts 2 and 11: lower only until your forearm is level, then start the next lift. All other lifts: full and strict.
Slow: 3 s up, 3 s down. Count out loud: 5 lifts. All full and strict.
Alternate arms; count only the sensor arm's lifts. Count out loud: 11 lifts. All full and strict.
Count out loud: 11 lifts. Lifts 3, 5 and 9: let your elbow swing forward as you lift, then bring it back. All other lifts: full and strict.
Count out loud: 5 lifts. Lifts 2, 3 and 4: let your elbow swing forward as you lift, then bring it back. All other lifts: full and strict.
Fast: as fast as you can while staying in control. Count out loud: 9 lifts. All full and strict.
Count out loud: 12 lifts. Lift 2: hold 2–3 s halfway up, then finish it. All other lifts: full and strict.

Count out loud: 10 lifts. Lifts 7 and 8: lift only until your forearm is level, then lower. Lifts 4 and 5: lower only until your forearm is level, then start the next lift. All other lifts: full and strict.
Walk around for about 15 s, arms natural. Not a set: the counter should say 0.
Curl until you can't do one more full rep. Count full reps only and TYPE that count at the prompt (Enter would record 0).
Same pendulum swings: elbow locked, palm facing your thigh, forward and back only.
